title: Add fail-closed Company B recovery primitives
objective: Starting only from the clean B-TASK-003 queue worker, add the small, independently testable primitives needed for a later revoke-first recovery state machine. This task does not wire the primitives into the main queue lifecycle. Treat B-TASK-009 and B-TASK-010 only as failure evidence; do not copy or salvage their worktree changes.
acceptance_criteria: Add one queue-state revocation helper whose successful return guarantees the target recovery-eligibility file is absent.
Revocation is idempotent when the file is already absent, but a deletion failure or still-present file must throw before any caller could publish GitHub lifecycle state.
Add strict save/load validation primitives for a versioned queue-state record containing issueNumber, taskId, derived task branch, phase, pullRequestNumber, and headSha.

Support only explicit phases needed by later integration: WORKER_PASS and PUBLISHED. WORKER_PASS must not accept a PR number or head marker; PUBLISHED must require a positive PR number and a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal head SHA.
Validation must reject invalid JSON, missing fields, schema mismatch, issue mismatch, malformed task id, task/branch mismatch, unknown phase, and phase-inconsistent PR/head fields.

Add executable regression tests using temporary local files for successful revocation, idempotent absence, locked-file deletion failure, and valid/invalid state records. Tests must not call GitHub, invoke company-b-worker.ps1, or alter persistent runtime state.
PowerShell self-test cleanup must use valid PowerShell syntax and must restore any temporary environment state it changes.

Do not change main queue discovery, lifecycle transitions, worker invocation, PR publication, evidence publication, documentation, scheduler, heartbeat, authoritative company-b-worker.ps1, Company A files, or trading code.
Keep the change small and localized; do not broadly rewrite company-b-queue-worker.ps1.
Full pytest suite and the queue worker -SelfTest must pass.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
